APIs.name: iteratedDeriv_mul
APIs.complete_API:
lemma iteratedDeriv_mul {f g : 𝕜 → 𝔸} (hf : ContDiffAt 𝕜 n f x) (hg : ContDiffAt 𝕜 n g x) :
    iteratedDeriv n (f * g) x = ∑ i ∈ .range (n + 1),
      n.choose i * iteratedDeriv i f x * iteratedDeriv (n - i) g x

APIs.name: Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedDeriv_eq
APIs.complete_API:
lemma Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedDeriv_eq (n : ℕ) {f g : 𝕜 → F} {x : 𝕜} (hfg : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g) :
    iteratedDeriv n f x = iteratedDeriv n g x

APIs.name: iteratedDeriv_succ'
APIs.complete_API: theorem iteratedDeriv_succ' : iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f = iteratedDeriv n (deriv f)

APIs.name: iteratedDeriv_mgf_zero
APIs.complete_API:
lemma iteratedDeriv_mgf_zero (h : 0 ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (mgf X μ) 0 = μ[X ^ n]

APIs.name: deriv_cgf
APIs.complete_API:
lemma deriv_cgf (h : v ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) :
    deriv (cgf X μ) v = μ[fun ω ↦ X ω * exp (v * X ω)] / mgf X μ v

APIs.name: deriv_mgf
APIs.complete_API:
lemma deriv_mgf (h : t ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) :
    deriv (mgf X μ) t = μ[fun ω ↦ X ω * exp (t * X ω)]
